verdict.rationale: Dagster+ is a hosted SaaS that handles customer pipeline data, so an AI-training data-usage policy or opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual commitment about AI model training on customer data. The AI-related items (MCP server, coding-agent skill) concern AI tooling, not data-usage privacy, so they are not credited here.
